utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, right, the repair drive! Cleo, I remember you asking about duct tape—I think I saw some in my garage, but I'm not sure if it's still there.

utterances.speaker: Vik
utterances.text: Vik: Yeah, I'm definitely bringing my old blender and broken lamp to the repair drive this Saturday!

utterances.speaker: Noah
utterances.text: Noah: Oh, Saturday, right! I keep forgetting the date. I'll try to remember to bring that wobbly chair and maybe dig up the duct tape if I can find it.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey, I think we're all set for Saturday! Oren mentioned he might have some tools to donate too.

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, that's great! I'll mark down Oren's tools for the inventory. Just to confirm, we're still using the community center parking lot, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yes, that's right — we're set for the community center parking lot starting at 9 a.m. on Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Bo, you planning to bring anything to the repair drive next Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: Oh, probably just some duct tape. I'll see what I have lying around.

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Oh nice, duct tape always comes in handy! Vik's bringing a blender and lamp—maybe they'll need some of that tape.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Hey Dane, I still haven't heard any updates on the repair drive. You know anything?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: I've been asking around too, but no one's given me a clear answer yet.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Maybe we should just check with the person organizing it directly?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Kira, I've been tracking supplies for the repair drive—do you have any spare tools or things like duct tape to offer?

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are we sure we even need a repair drive? I thought most folks around here already had their own tools.

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Sure, most people have their own, but the idea is to share extras so no one has to buy new—plus a few folks mentioned they’re short on things like duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Gus, have you heard about the repair drive at the community center Saturday? I'm bringing my toaster—it's been acting up!

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Yeah, I heard! I've got my toolbox ready. Want me to take a look at that toaster before Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Oh, that'd be wonderful, Gus! If you could fix it before the drive, I wouldn't have to haul it all the way down there.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Absolutely, Quinn! I'll make sure to remind all the parents at drop-off tomorrow morning.

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Thanks Faye! I'll have the drive ready, even if Alex doesn't come through.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, I'll spread the word. What's the deal with Alex?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: So the drive's arriving at noon—does that mean we're starting the fence repair at 10 sharp and pausing when the supplies come in?

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: That sounds tight—if the drive arrives exactly at noon, we'll have to stop mid-work. And how will we get the tools through without blocking the driveway?

utterances.speaker: Eli
utterances.text: Eli: Well, let's set a clear plan: we'll work on the fence from 10 to 11:30, then break for the drive's arrival, and finish up after it's unloaded.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! We're collecting old tools and things to fix up the community center.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: I'm sure it'll be great for the community. I just wish I had something useful to offer.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Don't you worry, Uli! Even if you don't have tools, maybe you could bring some old paintbrushes or something. I've got a rusty hammer somewhere in my garage, I think.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: I could help with fixing things, if you need an extra pair of hands.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: That's great, Rey! I'm sure they'd appreciate the help—I heard they're collecting tools down at the community center.

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Good, I'll head over there later and see what they need.

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: A repair drive? I still don't get what's being fixed around here.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Oh, we're fixing up the shared workshop and clearing the side path! Everyone's bringing tools on Saturday, it's gonna be a blast — you in?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Sounds useful. What time Saturday and what tools should I bring?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Hey Rosa, did you finally get that repair drive from Alex, or are we still waiting?

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, we're all set now! The drive's been moved to Sunday at the community center—hope you can still make it!

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought we were fixing my porch, not the community center—did we change the plan?

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Hey Sam, sorry I'm late. What's the plan for the repair drive?

utterances.speaker: Sam
utterances.text: Sam: Hey Dane, no worries! Alex is dropping off the drive by noon, so we'll have everything we need for Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Dane
utterances.text: Dane: Great, so we're all set for Saturday then. I'll be there bright and early.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: Wait, are you sure that repair drive is actually going to fix the problem, or are we just wasting our time?

utterances.speaker: Opal
utterances.text: Opal: Oh, it'll fix the problem alright—as long as everyone shows up at the right place, the lot behind the center.

utterances.speaker: Kira
utterances.text: Kira: And you honestly think everyone's going to show up?

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Wait, I thought we were fixing my porch, not the community center—did we change the plan?

utterances.speaker: Jules
utterances.text: Jules: Hey Mina, no change—we're definitely fixing your porch this weekend! I was just talking to Opal about the repair drive at the community center for next Saturday, separate thing.

utterances.speaker: Mina
utterances.text: Mina: Okay, good. So the porch is still on for noon tomorrow, right?

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Hey Leo! I'm glad you're here — are you still planning to bring by the old tools for the repair drive this Saturday?

utterances.speaker: Leo
utterances.text: Leo: Did I say I'd bring tools? Not sure what's broken.

utterances.speaker: Mara
utterances.text: Mara: Yeah, remember last week you mentioned you had some old tools in your garage that might be useful? It's for the community repair drive this Saturday.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: Hey Pia, have you heard about the repair drive? I just got wind of it from Mrs. Gable—sounds like a good way to pitch in around here.

utterances.speaker: Pia
utterances.text: Pia: Oh, I'm glad you brought it up—have we made a list of what everyone is bringing? I'd hate to have too many hammers and not enough nails.

utterances.speaker: Nell
utterances.text: Nell: No, I don't think we have a list yet. I guess we should probably figure that out—what do you think we need most?

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Thanks, Bo. I appreciate the offer.

utterances.speaker: Bo
utterances.text: Bo: No problem, just let me know if you need anything else. I'm heading out now.

utterances.speaker: Uli
utterances.text: Uli: Okay, bye Bo. Thanks again.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Hey Gus, can you clarify what the repair drive is actually for? I thought it was just for the community garden's water pump, but Vik mentioned bringing household items.

utterances.speaker: Gus
utterances.text: Gus: Well, Hana, it's for both—I'm fixing the park gate and folks are bringing other broken stuff too.

utterances.speaker: Hana
utterances.text: Hana: Oh, both? So it's not just the water pump then—are you sure the organizers planned for that? I don't want anyone to show up with the wrong things.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Hey Cleo, have you heard about the repair drive this Saturday? Quinn's counting on me to rally the morning crew—think you can help spread the word at school pickup?

utterances.speaker: Cleo
utterances.text: Cleo: Oh sure, I can mention it at pickup—gotta make sure folks know we still need a couple more rolls of duct tape.

utterances.speaker: Faye
utterances.text: Faye: Great, thanks Cleo! I think we're good on duct tape now, but we could use a few extra hands.

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: You know, Jules mentioned adding my toaster to the fix-it queue—maybe you could bring yours by too when you come for the fence work!

utterances.speaker: Rosa
utterances.text: Rosa: Oh, that reminds me—the repair drive just got moved to Sunday at the community center, so you'll have plenty of time to bring that toaster!

utterances.speaker: Tess
utterances.text: Tess: Sunday, you say? Well, that works even better—I can finally get that stubborn toaster fixed without rushing!

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Yeah, I just ran into Bo at the corner store—seems like there's a buzz about the drive, but I think the part situation is looking up.

utterances.speaker: Oren
utterances.text: Oren: Oh, the repair drive! I dug out some old wrenches from my garage—they might come in handy.

utterances.speaker: Ira
utterances.text: Ira: Nice, every bit helps! I also heard Vik's bringing his old lawnmower, so your wrenches might see some action.

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Hey Rey, you're coming to the repair drive on Saturday, right? We could really use your help!

utterances.speaker: Rey
utterances.text: Rey: Yeah, I'll be there. What do you need me to work on?

utterances.speaker: Quinn
utterances.text: Quinn: Great! I'm thinking you could help with the tool station—keep things organized and running smooth. People are already buzzing about it!
